stories.title: Anthropic researcher claims Claude solved the Riemann hypothesis
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he and the company's Claude AI have proven the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis. The announcement arrived one day after Anthropic's public stock offering. The proof remains unverified by the mathematics community, and the $1 million prize for a solution is currently unclaimed.

stories.title: Google removes search button from homepage in AI pivot
stories.summary: Google has officially removed the dedicated search button from its homepage, replacing it with buttons for image generation, file analysis, and brainstorming with Gemini. The company describes the change as an evolution of its flagship search experience. The search bar remains, though it now serves other purposes.

stories.title: Tone launches AI voice sales platform
stories.summary: Jordan Belfort and Shervin Pishevar have launched Tone, an AI voice sales platform that reportedly raised $10 million and generated $1 million in early revenue. Belfort claims the AI agents provide businesses with tighter control over sales scripts. The platform launched publicly on November 16.

stories.title: OpenAI updates GPT-6.2 to block reasoning extraction
stories.summary: OpenAI says it has reduced the success rate of attacks designed to extract internal reasoning from its models. Internal tests showed extraction success dropped from 54 percent on GPT-6 Astra to 0.2 percent on GPT-6.2 Astra. The company is now applying these defensive measures to other models.

stories.title: Signal restricts screenshots to counter AI agents
stories.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots on iOS and Android to prevent AI assistants from reading private messages. The company warned that OS-level agents like Siri and Gemini undermine encryption by pulling decrypted content from the display. Meta's AI agent reportedly captured Signal content prior to the update.

stories.title: Google Gemini gains background control of Mac applications
stories.summary: Google has introduced a feature allowing Gemini to run Mac apps and complete multistep tasks in the background. Users describe a goal, and the AI navigates menus and forms while the user continues working. Google says the system operates in an isolated window with live chat previews.

stories.title: Apple develops agent to operate Mac computers
stories.summary: Apple is hiring for a proactive AI assistant capable of performing multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, and command lines. The company describes the system as a general-purpose computer-use agent that requires strong permission models. Apple has eyed a launch as soon as late next year.

The project was revealed through new job listings on Apple’s careers website, according to a Bloomberg report published on November 19. The

stories.title: Apple joins the race for AI agents that control your device while raising new barriers for competitors
stories.summary: After Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google launched their own AI agents, Apple is now building one too - while making it harder for rivals to access its devices. According to a job listing, Apple is hiring a senior engineer to lead the project as a rival to Muse, Dots, Duet,

stories.title: Apple Developing AI Agent for Mac Computers | Udaipur Kiran
stories.summary: Apple is reportedly developing an AI agent to automate tasks on Macs, according to a job listing. NEW DELHI, Nov 20: Apple is reportedly developing an AI agent designed to automate various tasks on Mac computers. This information comes from a job listing posted by the company looking for a

stories.title: Siteimprove launches accessibility agent on AWS Marketplace
stories.summary: Siteimprove has launched an accessibility agent on the AWS Marketplace, allowing other AI agents to pay for its services per request. The platform aims to turn each request into a monetization event while buyers maintain governance. The company calls it agentic commerce.

stories.title: CERT-In reports unauthorized payments linked to AI cyberattacks
stories.summary: India’s cybersecurity agency reported unauthorized transactions at service providers for banks and financial institutions. The incidents involved technology firms supporting government-linked payments. Authorities are now increasing scrutiny of cyber risks across the financial sector.

stories.title: Goa cabinet approves AI policy for 2030
stories.summary: The Goa cabinet has approved an AI policy aiming to train 50,000 graduates by 2030. The government has allocated 60 per cent of the policy outlay to skilling and capacity building. Initiatives will cover all levels of education, including school and college students.

stories.title: Microsoft India launches multilingual AI chatbot for small businesses
stories.summary: Microsoft India and the Samhita-Collective Good Foundation have unveiled a multilingual chatbot to assist small businesses with daily operations. The tool follows a 60-day training programme for users. The government has not provided a date for a nationwide rollout.

stories.title: BluVaani AI call dispatcher launches for police helplines
stories.summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions has launched BluVaani, an AI voice dispatcher for police helplines that operates without an internet connection. During a pilot, the system handled 8,500 calls and flagged 1,500 potential fraud cases. The company did not name the state where the pilot occurred.

stories.title: Siemens introduces industrial AI agent in India
stories.summary: Siemens has launched its Eigen Engineering Agent in India to automate tasks like PLC coding and interface visualisation. The company claims the agent performs tasks two to five times faster than manual methods. Humans remain responsible for the final deployment of all work.

stories.title: Goa Wants to Train 50,000 Graduates in AI Skills
stories.summary: Key takeaways - Goa's AI Policy 2026 aims to train and certify 50,000 graduates in AI skills by 2030. - The policy allocates significant resources for AI skilling, startup support, and infrastructure development. - A Konkani language model and research centre will enhance AI capabilities for local languages. - Private-sector

stories.title: Accenture report finds AI content makes brands appear lazy
stories.summary: A report from Accenture Song found that 56 per cent of respondents in India believe brands using AI for advertising appear lazy, careless, and cheap. Consumers are reportedly seeking out more direct ties with creators as machine-generated content becomes easier to produce.

stories.title: India reports high phishing rates as awareness gaps persist
stories.summary: India and Indonesia share the highest phishing rate in the Asia-Pacific region, according to a Kaspersky survey. While 28 per cent of Indian businesses reported phishing incidents, 70 per cent of employees showed awareness gaps. Phishing remains the most frequently reported cyber incident.

stories.title: US chip export curbs may benefit Indian data centers
stories.summary: New US licensing requirements for advanced computing hardware in Southeast Asia and Brazil could increase investment in Indian data center operators. The shift follows regulatory uncertainty for operators in other regions. India is positioning itself to capture a larger share of global AI infrastructure investment.

stories.title: Forget Organic Growth, AI is Forcing Mid-Cap Indian IT to Reinvent M&A Playbook
stories.summary: Key takeaways - Acquisitions are crucial for mid-cap Indian IT firms, providing access to specialist skills and technology. - Coforge's Q2 results highlight the significant impact of acquisitions on revenue growth compared to organic growth. - Mid-tier firms are focusing on acquiring companies to enhance their expertise rather than just

stories.title: Call for Applications: AI and Digital Skills Program for CSOs (India) - fundsforNGOs - Grants and Resources for Sustaina
SAKAK secures strategic investment from DRB Dongil
stories.summary: SAKAK, an AI company specializing in hyper-personalized artificial intelligence, has raised about 200 million won from DRB Dongil. The startup issued 13,378 redeemable convertible preferred shares to the investor. Founded in 2022, the company holds technology for on-device hyper-personalized AI solutions.

stories.title: Khaime raises $500,000 for agentic commerce
stories.summary: Nigerian startup Khaime has raised $500,000 in pre-seed funding led by Launch Africa Ventures. The company is building a platform for human shoppers and AI agents to handle product discovery and purchase negotiations. It is betting on a shift toward merchants needing storefronts that interact directly with AI assistants.

stories.title: Healthcare AI startup Knit Health raises US$35m - Health Tech World
Paytm to invest in Singapore's Funding Societies
stories.summary: Paytm has received board approval to invest up to Rs 200 crore in Singapore-based Funding Societies. The company will acquire a 19.1% stake in CardUp, the digital payments arm of the firm, for about Rs 162 crore. The deal is expected to be completed by May 20, 2027.

stories.title: Ranketta raises €1 million and acquires Phemly
stories.summary: Czech startup Ranketta has raised €1 million and acquired Phemly. The company offers a platform to track product visibility in AI-generated search results from services like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. It aims to help e-commerce businesses monitor how their products appear in AI recommendations.

stories.title: Rahul Dravid-backed Disseqt AI raises $8 million led by Gresham House
stories.summary: Disseqt AI, a Dublin-headquartered startup that tests and monitors AI agents for large companies, has raised $8 million in a funding round led by Gresham House Ventures. Former Indian cricket captain Rahul Dravid invested in the round in his individual capacity. Sure Valley Ventures (SVV), Delta Partners and Enterprise Ireland

stories.title: Madrid-based Wilco secures €2.5 million to scale its AI patient follow-up platform across Europe - EU-Startups
Chipverse raises pre-seed funding for AI services
stories.summary: Egyptian startup Chipverse has raised pre-seed funding to pivot from GPU server rentals toward developer APIs and AI services for audio and video production. The company did not disclose the funding amount or a product launch date. The immediate change is a development push rather than a release.

stories.title: Urban Company raises Rs 2,500 crore via QIP
stories.summary: Urban Company has raised Rs 2,500 crore through a qualified institutional placement. The company reported total demand of Rs 15,000 crore for the issue. Proceeds will support the supply ecosystem for its InstaHelp service, brand marketing, and infrastructure. The shares were priced at a 3.1% discount.

stories.title: Humyn Labs raises $47 million for physical AI data
stories.summary: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A round to collect training data from factories and homes. The funding includes $26 million in equity led by Accel and $21 million in venture debt. The company aims to train AI systems and humanoid robots.

stories.title: Soket AI raises $4 million for EKA-1 model
stories.summary: Soket AI has raised $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies to support its new 26-billion-parameter foundation model, EKA-1. The model is designed to improve math and reasoning capabilities while supporting over 100 languages. The company prioritizes indigenous AI solutions and data security.

stories.title: Using AI, mathematician claims to have solved one of math’s great mysteries - The Washington Post
MIT-IBM researchers study multimodal AI fluency
stories.summary: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly mimicking human sensory integration, such as linking audio and visual data. However, researchers at the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab note that the apparent fluency of these systems often belies their actual understanding of the world they process.

stories.title: MIT researchers restrict AI models to physical laws
stories.summary: Researchers at MIT have developed a method to introduce physics-based restrictions on machine learning models. The approach aims to prevent models from drifting into physically impossible predictions when simulating chaotic systems like weather or ocean currents. The team is making the information freely available.

stories.title: Mathematicians discuss AI impact at MIT
stories.summary: Mathematicians at MIT recently gathered to discuss the rise of AI agents capable of solving complex problems in hours. The panel explored whether AI-driven productivity will affect human understanding of mathematical concepts and the future of the field as an intellectual pursuit.

stories.title: Industry addresses adversarial distillation risks
stories.summary: Adversarial distillation allows actors to reproduce the capabilities of frontier AI models without their original safeguards. By training new models on the outputs of protected systems, bad actors may deploy tools capable of cyberattacks. The industry is currently working to strengthen protections against this unauthorized use.

stories.title: US committee reveals AI chip export licenses
stories.summary: The US House Foreign Affairs Committee stated that the Commerce Department approved shipments of nearly 900,000 advanced AI chips to Chinese companies through May 2026. The committee reported that requested sales totaled 3.4 million chips, including exports to entities designated as Chinese military companies.

stories.title: Schumer criticizes Trump over AI chip exports to China
stories.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer accused President Trump of approving the sale of 800,000 advanced AI chips to Chinese firms in the six months since easing export controls. Schumer alleged that many of these chips were destined for companies with ties to the Chinese military.

stories.title: Corsair offers RTX 5090 prebuilt deal
stories.summary: Corsair is offering a prebuilt system featuring an RTX 5090, Ryzen 9 9950X3D, 64GB of RAM, and 4TB of storage. While prices for such systems have recently spiked into five-figure territory, the company is marketing this configuration as a discount ahead of the Black Friday rush.

stories.title: Space data centers face financing hurdles
stories.summary: Building data centers in orbit requires more than just rockets. The industry currently relies on debt financing where chips serve as collateral for loans. According to Compute Credit Index Research, some H100 chips are selling for about half their original price, which may complicate their utility as loan security.

stories.title: Ten nations sign AI supply chain declaration
stories.summary: India, the U.S., and eight other countries have signed the San Francisco Declaration to treat AI supply chains as a shared endeavor. The agreement, part of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative, aims to secure silicon and minerals essential for semiconductor production across the participating nations.

stories.title: Jensen Huang exit fuels speculation on China chip limits
stories.summary: The departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has triggered debate regarding the future of AI chip manufacturing and U.S. technology restrictions. Analysts suggest the shift may influence global AI infrastructure and potentially provide new opportunities for India as the U.S. continues to escalate its export controls on Beijing.

stories.title: VAST Data says petabyte SSDs will outgrow RAID
stories.summary: VAST Data claims petabyte SSDs will soon outgrow traditional RAID systems. A simulation of its 900 PB system suggests a 1 in 11 chance of data loss over ten years. The company notes that while larger drives take longer to rebuild, they remain necessary for power-constrained sites.

stories.title: Phison details SSD with built-in NPU
stories.summary: Phison has unveiled two enterprise SSD designs, including one with a built-in NPU and 64GB of memory to run AI frameworks like PyTorch directly on the drive. The company claims the design offers up to 100 times less data transfer. Neither design currently has a product name.

stories.title: Lawyer builds private AI server with used V100s
stories.summary: A lawyer has upgraded a private server using 12 used Nvidia V100 GPUs to run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The system reportedly achieves 184 tokens per second for code. The owner claims the setup outperforms published DGX Spark stacks on single requests at half the cost of three units.

stories.title: Power limits force AI clusters across multiple regions
stories.summary: Power and cooling constraints are pushing AI clusters with over 100,000 accelerators beyond the capacity of single data centers. Researchers at SC26 noted that companies like Google and Cisco are now targeting scale-across networking architectures to connect compute resources across multiple geographical regions.

stories.title: TSMC and Samsung pause shipments to China
stories.summary: TSMC and Samsung have reportedly paused shipments of certain chips to Chinese clients following new U.S. export rules. Both companies are currently seeking export licenses from the U.S. Commerce Department. Chinese tech firms are already facing component shortages and rising prices for memory chips.

stories.title: OpenAI helps AMD optimize GPU design
stories.summary: OpenAI engineers used AI models to help AMD optimize its upcoming flagship GPU and CPU designs, resulting in a 14 percent improvement in power, performance, and area for the GPU. The collaboration reportedly condensed a year of chip development work into under five months.

stories.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero target
stories.summary: Meta is rethinking its goal to reach net-zero emissions by 2030 following a record increase in greenhouse gas emissions. The company attributed the shift to the environmental demands of building new AI data centers. Executives claim their long-term ambitions remain, despite the changing operating environment.

stories.title: Advertising worker loses home after layoffs
stories.summary: An Australian advertising worker is selling his home after being made redundant four times since 2019. He attributed his financial strain to a slowing economy and the increased adoption of AI in the workplace. He has been unable to secure full-time employment since February 2025.

stories.title: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs and launches AI studio
stories.summary: Ubisoft has laid off 166 employees in Montreal and Quebec, primarily in production and support roles. The company simultaneously announced the launch of Motherbrain, a subsidiary focused on generative AI. Ubisoft has reduced its total workforce by roughly 1,100 people since April 2026.

stories.title: Salesforce initiates another round of layoffs
stories.summary: Salesforce has begun a new round of job cuts, according to internal messages. The company has not disclosed the total number of affected roles. This follows previous workforce reductions earlier in the year as the firm adjusts to shifting spending priorities.

stories.title: Ubisoft bets on AI studio amid layoffs
stories.summary: Ubisoft is launching a generative AI game development studio while simultaneously cutting 166 staff members. The publisher, known for the Assassin’s Creed franchise, has cancelled several in-development projects this year. The company has not commented on the overlap between the layoffs and the new AI investment.

stories.title: 90 percent of Indian employers expanding tech teams
stories.summary: A Randstad report finds that 90 percent of Indian employers are increasing their technology workforce to scale AI services. India now holds the second-highest proportion of companies expanding tech teams globally, trailing only the United States. The research was conducted during the first half of August 2026.

stories.title: AI-exposed jobs in China fall faster than others
stories.summary: A Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings indicates that roles highly exposed to AI in China declined 10 percentage points faster than less affected positions between 2021 and 2025. The data suggests that AI is adding pressure to an already struggling labor market.

stories.title: With AI blamed for mass layoffs, here's how we can ensure workers get a fairer deal - Phys.org
ServiceNow shares slide as AI demand concerns persist
stories.summary: ServiceNow shares fell 1.9 percent Wednesday and another 1.6 percent Thursday as investors retreated from AI-linked stocks. The company's bookings guidance landed below market expectations. While the broader S&P 500 also declined, analysts noted investor anxiety that the AI boom may be cooling.

stories.title: Ubisoft launches Motherbrain AI studio
stories.summary: Ubisoft has unveiled Motherbrain, a new subsidiary focused on generative AI for gameplay innovation. The studio consists of the team behind the company's first playable generative AI experience. Ubisoft describes the unit as a way to empower creators, though it provided few specific details on output.

stories.title: Qualcomm and Salesforce trim India workforces
stories.summary: Qualcomm has reportedly begun layoffs affecting over 1,000 employees in India, while Salesforce has initiated another round of cuts. The restructuring follows a broader industry trend of trimming teams amid an increased focus on AI integration. The companies have not detailed how these shifts impact long-term hiring.

stories.title: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs alongside AI studio launch
stories.summary: Ubisoft has laid off 166 employees in Montreal and Quebec City while establishing Motherbrain, its new generative AI subsidiary. The company is reducing its current workforce to prioritize experimental technology. Management has yet to provide evidence of the commercial benefits of this transition for the affected staff.

stories.title: Musk's SpaceXAI lobbies Chilean government
stories.summary: SpaceXAI held nine lobbying sessions with Chilean officials between July and October 2026. The company pitched Grok for fraud detection and tax analysis across multiple ministries. No formal agreements were reached, though the meetings suggest the company is laying the groundwork for future government procurement.

stories.title: South Korea uses disaster alerts to stop exam cheating
stories.summary: South Korea deployed emergency disaster alerts during national college admission exams to detect prohibited devices. The measure follows a cheating scandal involving AI and micro-cameras in a tax accountant exam. The government is attempting to curb an epidemic of high-tech academic dishonesty.

stories.title: Researchers find widespread data leaks in AI supply chain
stories.summary: Researchers planted 2 million digital tripwires across various AI services to track how sensitive information is handled. The experiment revealed that many AI routers and gateways leak user data. The findings suggest that information entrusted to AI brokers is frequently exposed to third-party systems.

stories.title: Opinion | Anthropic warned investors what could go wrong. Educators and parents should listen. - Star Tribune
Elvis Presley estate sues Anthropic for copyright infringement
stories.summary: The Elvis Presley estate has sued Anthropic for 46.6 million dollars, alleging the company used 274 of the singer's songs to train its AI models without permission. The lawsuit is one of the first of its kind from a recording artist's estate against an AI firm.

stories.title: Trump threatens tax on offshore data centers
stories.summary: President Trump threatened a tremendous tax on companies that build AI data centers outside the United States. The statement followed a summit with international leaders. While Trump opposes offshore construction, cities and states across the country are currently placing their own restrictions on new data center projects.

stories.title: Ninth Circuit hears xAI challenge to disclosure law
stories.summary: The Ninth Circuit is weighing a challenge from xAI against a California law requiring generative AI developers to disclose training data summaries. The court is considering whether the mandate constitutes compelled speech. The law, which took effect in 2026, aims to provide consumers with more transparency.

stories.title: UK lawmaker sues SpaceXAI over deepfake imagery
stories.summary: A British lawmaker has sued SpaceXAI in London's High Court over sexualized deepfake images generated by the Grok chatbot. The case aims to determine if an AI developer is liable for the design of its system. The company has denied privacy liability in the matter.

We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We study active exploration for minimax transition estimation in unknown Markov decision processes (MDPs). Frequentist $\kappa$-Explorer~\citep{gu2026kappa} addresses this problem through a parameterized family of exploration objectives, but requires confidence-bound constructions and joint optimization over plausible transition. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on stored records to recover a person's state as facts change. Reliable answers depend on how facts are recorded, retrieved, and presented to the reader. We treat a long-form persona dossier as a. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: DRVEXO-4B-Unified: Design and Evaluation of a Modular Speech-Vision System
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We present DRVEXO-4B-Unified, a modular multimodal assistant built around a 4B language backbone.
